snippet.title: You Vs Zombies - GDC 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
The world has ended. Humanity has fallen. Only three wizards remain in the ruins: Ash, Morgan, and YOU.

A desperate plan is formed: in order to save the world from the zombie hordes, YOU must sacrifice your body and using The Ritual, magically return to the start of the outbreak in search of a new body to possess - anyone with just a head and torso will do… 

The Ritual takes the information you feed into it, and (using various LLM technologies that we’ve trained to understand our hand crafted story bible, art style, gameplay structures, objectives and constraints) creates a personalised gaming experience starring YOU!

Whether you become a fire-breathing ballerina, a spell-slinging grunge-rocker, or a tsunami-riding mai-tai surfer, you now have one mission: travel back through time to face the trauma, rewrite the future, and fix the apocalypse. Armed with nothing but magic, bad decisions, and someone else’s face, if you kill enough zombies, then maybe, just maybe, you can fix humanity’s mess in a very roguelite way (Or… y’know… make it worse.)
